figures.claim: 1. Figure 1: Validation loss curves for enwik8 dataset
figures.explanation: Execution stage: Figure 1 validation loss curves for enwik8 require all_results.npy as input to plot.py. This file is missing from all run directories. Reproduction requires first generating enwik8 data via prepare.py, then running run_3.py (100K iterations for enwik8 alone, plus shakespeare_char and text8 runs) — hours of GPU training that is impractical given the GPU is already heavily loaded. The code path is plausible but the evidence is insufficient to verify or falsify the figure.
figures.evidence: val_loss_enwik8.png exists in repo root (pre-existing image, insufficient for verification). all_results.npy is absent from all run directories (run_0 through run_3). enwik8 data directory contains only prepare.py with no train.bin/val.bin. plot.py:17 reads all_results.npy to generate the validation loss curves. | Code: plot.py:17 — np.load(osp.join(folder, 'all_results.npy'), allow_pickle=True); run_3.py:734 — np.save(f, all_results)
